name: Jeremy Miller
source:
A calm and quiet person. He’s extremely protective of his friends... if he’s paying attention in the first place. He loves coffee... a lot, and and can get irritable if he doesn't get his daily coffee fix.

Jeremy is extremely close with Rachael, and after defending her from Theo in middle school the two of them have been inseparable since then.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/welcome-jeremy-47604363]character introduction[/url]]
